full_judgment: SM Ziaul Karim J: This Rule Nisi was issued, calling upon the respondent to show cause as to why threatening for eviction of the petitioner Nos. 2-5 and thousands of other slum dwellers from their peaceful possession of their homestead at Gudaraghat/Vashantek Basti, CS Plot Nos. 776 & 777 Mouza Zoarashahara, JL No, 271, Khatian No. 127, west Vashantek/Gudaraghat section 15 Ward No. (old) 4 (New 95) PS, Kafrul, District Dhaka, without due process of law should not be declared illegal and without lawful authority being contrary to right to life as mandated by Article 32 of the Constitution.
